en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Salih Bin Abu Hammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Wahab Al Hareyri, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The buyer of the real estate receives sustenance, and the seller of it is annihilated’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Ali has narrated from Salih ibn abu Hammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Wahab al-Haririy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The buyer of real property receives sustenance and the seller thereof suffers a serious loss.”
